title: Brave browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each Brave profile is a separate browsing identity with its own history, bookmarks and wallets. Its presence shows the browser was used and how many identities were kept apart.
source: Chromium user data directory docs (Brave uses the Chromium layout under BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser): https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: Matches the Preferences marker file so non-profile folders are skipped. Brave Browser Beta and Nightly use separate folders next to this one.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Brave, export your passwords from the password manager settings page, and export bookmarks from the bookmarks manager.
cleanup.signOut: In Brave, open Settings > Sync and choose Leave Sync Chain, so this computer stops syncing with your other devices.
steps: Uninstall Brave from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Brave user data folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Deletes every Brave profile on this PC: history, bookmarks, saved passwords, cookies, extensions and any Brave wallet.
cleanup.source: Brave Help Center, How do I set up Sync: https://support.brave.com/hc/en-us/articles/360021218111-How-do-I-set-up-Sync
